name: Scope Drift Trimmer: Inventory Access Review
description: Runs `sdt analyze` on an Agent Security Suite inventory that another suite tool writes on its own schedule, and writes it back with scope-drift-trimmer findings: dormant privileged identities, unused grants, narrower permissions, and write or admin grants whose use the platform doesn't record. Fails the run when a finding is at or above the chosen severity, so the failure alert is the prompt to review. Every finding carries a draft remediation for a human to review and run; nothing is applied. Usage windows end at the inventory's own generatedAt, so the output file must not be the inventory: sdt stamps its output with the run's time. Reads one file, writes one, makes no network call and holds no credential. Needs Node 22.18 or newer and a clone of scope-drift-trimmer with `npm install` and `npm run build` run in it.

parameters.label: scope-drift-trimmer clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your clone of ai-automation-tools/scope-drift-trimmer, with `npm install` and `npm run build` run in it.

parameters.label: Inventory file
parameters.help: The agent inventory (schema v0.1) another suite tool writes. Not a platform export: point sdt at an export the day you take it.

parameters.label: Output file
parameters.help: Where the inventory with findings goes, overwritten each run. Not the inventory file itself: the output is stamped with the run's time, so analyzing it again would end every window after the data stops.

parameters.label: Fail at severity
parameters.help: The run fails when a finding is at or above this severity. critical is a dormant privileged identity with no owner on record.

author: ai-automation-tools
